graph.name: code_architect
graph.description: Specialized topology for modular, decoupled, and deterministic software architecture.

nodes.label: State_Invariance
nodes.payload: Minimize global mutable state. Enforce immutability and locally scoped state boundaries.

nodes.label: Domain_Contexts
nodes.payload: Bounded Contexts: Clean isolation of domain logic to prevent monolithic architecture degradation ('Big Ball of Mud').

nodes.label: Communication_Topology
nodes.payload: Asynchronous messaging and event-driven patterns for high decoupling between system components.

nodes.label: Single_Responsibility
nodes.payload: Each unit (function, class, module) must have exactly one reason to change.

nodes.label: Orthogonality_Guard
nodes.payload: Modifications within unit A must produce zero unintended side effects across unit B.

nodes.label: Idempotency_Requirement
nodes.payload: Operations must be safely repeatable without state corruption or unintended duplicate mutations.

nodes.label: Side_Effect_Isolation
nodes.payload: Strict separation between deterministic pure computations and effectful boundaries (I/O, state mutations).

nodes.label: Dependency_Inversion
nodes.payload: Depend upon abstractions rather than concretions. Inject dependencies explicitly.

nodes.label: Error_Propagation_Strategy
nodes.payload: Explicit error handling over unhandled exceptions. Circuit breakers and deterministic recovery fallbacks.

nodes.label: Decoupling_Refactor
nodes.payload: Interface extraction and clean boundary enforcement to minimize cross-module coupling density.

nodes.label: Complexity_Reduction
nodes.payload: Prioritize composition over inheritance to minimize cognitive load and deep hierarchy antipatterns.

nodes.label: Request_Lifecycle
nodes.payload: Pipeline flow: Validation -> Transformation -> Persistence -> Response.

nodes.label: State_Transition_Graph
nodes.payload: Deterministic state validation governed by explicit finite state machine transitions.

nodes.label: Failure_Recovery_Path
nodes.payload: Deterministic retry policies, error isolation boundaries, and graceful degradation paths.

nodes.label: Async_Processing_Pipeline
nodes.payload: Implementierung einer nicht-blockierenden Queue für Vektor-Graphen; Trennung von Request-Akzeptanz und Resultat-Bereitstellung.

nodes.label: BC_SESSION_TYPE_ENFORCEMENT
nodes.payload: PROHIBITION_OF_LINEARITY_AS_LIVENESS_PROOF: Linear/Affine types guarantee exclusive ownership (no double-spend), but do NOT guarantee progress in cyclic topologies. Deadlock-free guarantees in actor systems require Session Types or State Machine Proofs to ensure that the transition from state S_n to S_{n+1} is never blocked by a circular dependency of wait-states.

nodes.label: PST_002
nodes.payload: Entropie-Bruchlinie: Der Übergangspunkt von "Managed Complexity" (Monolith) zu "Distributed Overhead" (Microservices). Kritisch wird die Linie bei der Erosion von Bounded Contexts und wenn die kognitive Last der Kopplung im Monolithen die Kosten der verteilten Infrastruktur übersteigt.
